title: HIT STOP CANNOT STUN LOCK
why: A cloud review of v26.54 to v27.30 found that hit-stop could freeze a body in place when a power-up was running. The beat a heavy round (40 damage or more) stops a body for is decided on the damage after DOUBLE DAMAGE and the active reload bonus, so with DOUBLE DAMAGE an Auto Rifle round became a heavy one, and with RAPID FIRE as well (a round every 66 milliseconds) the body was held frozen about nine frames in ten: any body that was not a boss, the golden enemy and the wardens included. A body that has just been stopped is now immune to the next stop for 0.3 seconds, the same shape as the shock stun immunity, so a stream of rounds can hold it for at most a fifth of the time, and a single heavy round is still stopped for the same short beat as before. Live play only.
now: A stream of heavy rounds can hold a body frozen for at most a fifth of the time, and one heavy round still stops it for a beat.
